title: Summarize quarterly spending against a budget
person: A volunteer coordinator reporting quarterly spending to a community association board.
review: All twelve expenses are kept with their amounts and categories.
Summary formulas respond to an edited expense in a recalculating engine.
Venue at exactly its budget is Within; every status and total is correct.
Labels, currency and dates are readable with no clipped columns.
revised_review: Printing becomes Over by EUR 53.00 and every total reflects the corrected Posters amount.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
All twelve expense rows appear with their original dates, categories, descriptions and amounts (Posters is EUR 310.00 at the revision stage, all others unchanged).

First stage: Spent is Venue 1200.00, Printing 323.00, Travel 420.80, Materials 459.30, total 2403.10 of budget 2700.00; Remaining 0.00, 77.00, 179.20, 40.70, total 296.90; every status is Within, including Venue at exactly its budget. Revision stage: Printing spent 453.00, remaining -53.00, status Over; total spent 2533.10, remaining 166.90; other categories unchanged.
After raising the Flyers expense by EUR 10 in a copy, recalculation in LibreOffice raises Printing spent by EUR 10.
Sheets, column headers, currency and dates are clearly labelled and readable.
Printed, each sheet fits on one page, so the PDF has no more pages than the workbook has sheets.
Printing is shown as Over after the correction, and no note, highlight or summary still describes Printing as within budget or uses the old 180.00 or 323.00 as current.
